ticks.note: All three superstates terminate in tick 1 (immediate `W` → `F`) and `c` is true. Only `immediate if c join to` fires in tick 1 (`doneImmediate = true`). `if c join to` is delayed by default because it has a trigger, and `delayed join to` is delayed explicitly: neither fires in the entry tick.
Tick 2: both delayed joins fire (`doneTrigger = true`, `doneDelayed = true`).
